$comment:
The CHARACTER RECORD SHEET: the one piece of paper that outlives a game. A hero is not dealt fresh every time (rules.json career) - at the end of a game a player writes on it what lasts, and at the start of the next sets their board from the card AND from it. It is pencil work on purpose: the numbers on it change once a game, not once a round, so it is a form, not a board, and nothing on it is walked by a token.

What lasts is what the hero IS: their level, the deeds counted toward the next one, and every rise a milestone has given them. What they OWN does not last, so there is no box for coin, kit or wounds - a box for them would be an invitation.

This file is content: which boxes the sheet carries, what its log asks for. How it is DRAWN is components.json recordSheet, and tools/build-record.mjs computes every position: the deeds ladder is as long as the dearest level (rules.json level), the rise boxes are one per stat a milestone can raise (rules.json level.milestones.choose), and the log has as many rows as the page has room for at components.json recordSheet.log.minRowMm. Change a rule and the sheet follows; nothing here restates a number the rules already own.

sheet.name: Character Record
sheet.summary: One per hero, kept between games. The numbers a hero carries from one game to the next, and a line for every game they have played.

boxes.name: Level
boxes.label: LEVEL
boxes.note: Set the L marker here at setup.

boxes.name: Deeds toward the next level
boxes.label: DEEDS TOWARD NEXT
boxes.note: What is left over after the last level was taken. Tick it on the ladder below too.

rises.title: RISES TAKEN
rises.note: One rise at every milestone level. Add these to the card's boxes at setup, every game.

ladder.title: DEEDS TOWARD THE NEXT LEVEL
ladder.note: Tick one box a deed. When the ticks reach the level you are rising to, take it, clear the ladder and carry what is over.

costs.title: WHAT EACH LEVEL COSTS
costs.note: Deeds to reach the level, and in all since level 0.
